summary: Iteration 4 hardening verified. Backend 25/25 pass (regression + enum 422s + JWT cookie login/refresh + 6th-attempt brute-force lockout 429 + admin cookie auth + PATCH notification record + Stripe 404/webhook 400 + PayPal config/order/webhook + bookings rate-limit 429). Frontend: hero 3D canvas renders, chat widget present, store shows Stripe buy-now-1 + paypal-buttons-1 (9 iframes), admin login redirects to /admin, tab-bookings + tab-orders present, orders-list renders 15 payment_transactions rows, status buttons present, lazy /payment/cancel route loads.
critical_code_review_comments: Notification delivery is intentionally not wired (records only) — noted in mocked_api.

test_bookings_rate_limit trips 429 as expected; other tests that also POST /api/bookings are ordered before it in this file. If another suite runs the rate-limit test first, later booking tests could see 429; test_patch_booking_creates_notification already retries.
Auth refresh: since JWT exp is second-resolution, back-to-back refresh calls within the same second produce identical access tokens — expected behaviour; test now sleeps 1.1s. Not a bug.
brute-force lockout key is per (IP + email), and after 5 fails count is reset alongside setting locked_until. Behaviour matches playbook.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_ bookings + notifications inserted; a Stripe checkout session + PayPal sandbox order created as side effects of /api/payments/checkout and /api/paypal/orders tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 4 all-green. /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py is the canonical iteration-4 suite; earlier suites (backend_test.py, test_iteration2.py, test_paypal.py) still valid. If rerunning shortly, bookings/login rate limits may already be near their windows; wait ~5 min or use fresh IP.
